research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Spire Global is advancing satellite technology through systems for command and control of satellite constellations, optimizing tasks for satellites and ground stations, and enhancing cubesat communication systems. Their research includes methods for tasking satellite constellations and optimizing multi-use spacecraft in low Earth orbit. Additionally, they are developing systems to improve data transmission from cubesats to ground stations and methods to reduce noise in GNSS signal observations. These efforts support Spire Global's focus on maritime, aviation, and weather tracking.

overview_description.description: Spire is a global provider of space-based data, analytics, and space services, offering access to unique datasets and powerful insights about Earth from the ultimate vantage point so that organizations can make decisions with confidence, accuracy, and speed. Spire uses one of the world’s largest multi-purpose satellite constellations to source hard to acquire, valuable data and enriches it with predictive solutions. Spire then provides this data as a subscription to organizations around the world so they can improve business operations, decrease their environmental footprint, deploy resources for growth and competitive advantage, and mitigate risk. Spire gives commercial and government organizations the competitive advantage they seek to innovate and solve some of the world’s toughest problems with insights from space.

about_short_description.short_description: Spire Global is a space to cloud data analytics company utilizing satellites to provide maritime, aviation, and weather tracking.

product.name: Aviation Data and Analytics
product.description: Global real-time and historical flight tracking data derived from satellite-based ADS-B and terrestrial sources, delivered through APIs, streams, and ready-to-use files.

product.name: Weather and Climate Data Services
product.description: Atmospheric observations and weather intelligence from low-Earth-orbit satellites and radio occultation, supporting forecasting, climate analysis, and operational planning.

product.name: Space Services
product.description: End-to-end satellite infrastructure for deploying customer payloads, software, and data missions, including satellite manufacturing, launch coordination, ground connectivity, and in-orbit operations.

product.name: Maritime Data and Analytics
product.description: Satellite-based maritime tracking and weather intelligence for monitoring vessels, optimizing voyages, and improving supply-chain and environmental visibility.

product.name: Space Reconnaissance
product.description: Radio-frequency intelligence services that detect, characterize, and geolocate signals, including GNSS jamming, spoofing, and other signal disruptions.

product.name: Government and Defence Data Solutions
product.description: Mission-oriented aviation, weather, environmental, maritime, and radio-frequency intelligence services for government and defence situational awareness.
